content.short: Omnichain version of Tether's USDT and XAUt, moving between networks without wrapped copies.
content.description: USDT0 brings Tether's dollar and gold tokens to many chains while keeping one unified supply, so liquidity is not split across different bridged versions. More than $3.6 billion is in circulation and over $112 billion has moved through it, with an average transfer above $100,000. It launched Plasma with record day-one stablecoin liquidity, and it is also the native gas and base asset on Stable.
content.meta: USDT0 moves Tether's USDT and XAUt across chains as one unified supply, with $112B+ transferred.
